part.text:
Fixed `CarbonInterval::fromString()` to accept scientific-notation numeric values, so the tiny fractional-second remainder from `CarbonInterval::make('PT13.000001S')` parses instead of throwing.

Validation: `tests/CarbonInterval` passes (430 tests, 1116 assertions). Full suite only shows an unrelated date-dependent failure in `CarbonPeriod\CreateTest::testStartAndEndFallback`.
